title: A2UI Ad Component: Non-Intrusive Sponsored Generative UI & Multi-Agent Auction Engine in Google ADK
description: Production-grade generative UI monetization and multi-agent test suite implementing A2UI v0.9 (AdBanner & SponsoredCard) within Google Agent Development Kit (google-adk). Features deterministic lifecycle ad injection, second-price Vickrey auctions, content-grounded educational gating, live SerpApi search ads retrieval, and multi-turn SSE streaming.
